ADMIN_PASSWORD.name: Admin Password
ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: REQUIRED. Password to log into the OpenTrader UI (email: onboarding@opentrader.pro). Auto-generated per deployment via ${{secret(16)}} — copy the generated value from the service's Variables tab after deploy. Change it to your own to keep logins stable across redeploys.

DATABASE_URL.name: Database URL
DATABASE_URL.description: SQLite database location on the persistent /app/data volume, via the RAILWAY_VOLUME_MOUNT_PATH reference. Change only if you know what you are doing.
